description: This shell script is part of the platform upgrade utilities for a device using OpenWRT. It includes functions for checking the partition layout and sizes, verifying the device's board name, and performing firmware upgrades by extracting firmware parts and writing them to MTD partitions.

methods.name: gemini_check_redboot_parts
methods.description: Checks the partition sizes and names against expected values, validating the layout for the device's firmware upgrade process.

methods.name: gemini_do_platform_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the extraction and writing of firmware components (kernel, ramdisk, application) to the appropriate MTD partitions during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines whether the current device supports an upgrade based on its board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing the upgrade based on board type, delegating to specific functions as needed.
